answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 58200 Country: India Title: salam Question: Can we say salam to Shia (Borah) Muslims? Answer ID: 58200 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 211/211/SD=05/1436) One should say “WalaikumAssalamWa-rahmatullahWa-barakatuh”in the reply of the salam of those Shias who are fasiq, but one should simply say “Walaikum” while replying the salam of those Shia who are kafirs as per their belief. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
